note: Environment verification and model selection for Phase 2 experiments

hardware.nand_note: Internal SSD; 16 GB unified memory fits 7B/8B Q4 models completely in RAM.

ollama.api_note: All experiment code uses REST API /api/generate with think=false, seed=42, temperature=0.

second_model.name: llama3.1:8b
second_model.stated_limitation: This is a model rater (different vendor family), not a human rater.

benchmark_qwen3_6_comparison.finding: qwen3.6 exceeds 16GB unified memory causing heavy NVMe swapping (~0.23 tok/s), whereas qwen2.5:7b fits entirely in RAM achieving 22.2 tok/s (~96x faster). qwen2.5:7b selected as primary model.

cost.note: All inference local via Ollama. Zero cloud APIs used.
